description: Statistics on the family-wide presequence rule (Fisher exact, Mann-Whitney, length excess), SGD GO annotation record for MIS1, and a scan for internal in-frame ATG codons that could yield a cytosolic Mis1 isoform
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, mannwhitneyu

# ---------- rebuild family panel (self-contained) ----------
def usearch(q, fields="accession,id,protein_name,organism_name,sequence,ft_transit,cc_subcellular_location,length"):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"fields":fields,"size":500,"format":"json"},timeout=120); r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json().get("results",[])
recs=usearch('(reviewed:true) AND (family:"formate--tetrahydrofolate ligase family") AND (taxonomy_id:2759)')
EIS=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
         L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
def muh(s,w=18):
    b=0.
    for i in range(0,max(1,len(s)-w+1)):
        x=s[i:i+w]
        if len(x)<w: continue
        a=np.deg2rad(100*np.arange(len(x))); h=np.array([EIS.get(c,0.) for c in x])
        b=max(b,float(np.hypot((h*np.cos(a)).sum(),(h*np.sin(a)).sum())/len(x)))
    return b
rows=[]
for rc in recs:
    seq=rc["sequence"]["value"]
    if len(seq)<200: continue
    locs=[sl["location"]["value"] for c in rc.get("comments",[]) if c["commentType"]=="SUBCELLULAR LOCATION"
          for sl in c.get("subcellularLocations",[])]
    tp=[f["location"]["end"]["value"] for f in rc.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Transit peptide"]
    s=seq[:34]; R=s.count("R");K=s.count("K");D=s.count("D");E=s.count("E")
    rows.append(dict(acc=rc["primaryAccession"], id=rc.get("uniProtkbId"),
        organism=rc.get("organism",{}).get("scientificName",""), length=len(seq),
        loc="; ".join(sorted(set(locs))) or "unannotated", tp_end=tp[0] if tp else 0,
        has_tp=bool(tp), net_charge=R+K-D-E, acidic=D+E, muH=muh(s)))
d=pd.DataFrame(rows)
d["compartment"]=np.where(d["loc"].str.contains("Mitochond"),"mitochondrial",
                  np.where(d["loc"].str.contains("Cytoplasm|Cytosol"),"cytoplasmic","other"))
fam=d[d.compartment.isin(["mitochondrial","cytoplasmic"])]

print("### Family-wide rule: transit peptide annotation vs compartment")
ct=pd.crosstab(fam.compartment,fam.has_tp)
print(ct.to_string())
odds,p=fisher_exact(ct.values)
print(f"Fisher exact p = {p:.5f}  (perfect concordance, {ct.values.sum()} eukaryotic family members)")

mt=fam[fam.compartment=="mitochondrial"]; cy=fam[fam.compartment=="cytoplasmic"]
for v in ["net_charge","acidic","length"]:
    u,pp=mannwhitneyu(mt[v],cy[v])
    print(f"  {v:11s} mito median {mt[v].median():.1f} vs cyto median {cy[v].median():.1f}  "
          f"MWU p={pp:.4f}  AUC={u/(len(mt)*len(cy)):.2f}")
print(f"  mean length excess of mitochondrial members: {mt.length.mean()-cy.length.mean():.1f} aa")
print(f"  mean annotated transit peptide length in this family: {mt.tp_end.mean():.1f} aa")

# ---------- SGD record for MIS1 ----------
print("\n### SGD backend record for MIS1")
try:
    sg=requests.get("https://www.yeastgenome.org/backend/locus/S000000262/go_details",timeout=60)
    if sg.status_code!=200:
        loc=requests.get("https://www.yeastgenome.org/backend/locus/MIS1",timeout=60).json()
        sgid=loc.get("sgdid"); print("  resolved SGDID:", sgid)
        sg=requests.get(f"https://www.yeastgenome.org/backend/locus/{sgid}/go_details",timeout=60)
    go=sg.json()
    seen=set()
    for g in go:
        t=g.get("go",{}).get("display_name"); asp=g.get("go",{}).get("go_aspect")
        ev=g.get("eco",{}).get("display_name") if isinstance(g.get("eco"),dict) else g.get("annotation_type")
        ref=g.get("reference",{}).get("display_name")
        key=(t,ev,ref)
        if key in seen: continue
        seen.add(key)
        print(f"  [{asp}] {t:55s} | {str(ev)[:28]:28s} | {ref}")
except Exception as e:
    print("  SGD fetch failed:", repr(e))

# ---------- alternative translation initiation check ----------
MIS1="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P09440.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
print("\n### Could an internal AUG give a cytosolic Mis1 isoform?")
mets=[i+1 for i,c in enumerate(MIS1[:120]) if c=="M"]
print("  Met positions in Mis1 1-120:", mets)
print("  Mature N-terminus (residue 35) =", MIS1[34], "- not Met, so the mature protein does not start at an AUG")
nextM=[m for m in mets if m>1]
print("  First internal Met after the presequence:", nextM[0] if nextM else "none within 120",
      "-> initiating there would delete", (nextM[0]-1) if nextM else None, "residues of the catalytic domain")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
colors={"mitochondrial":"#d1495b","cytoplasmic":"#4c8dbd"}
for comp,g in fam.groupby("compartment"):
    ax.scatter(g.net_charge,g.acidic,s=130,c=colors[comp],edgecolor="k",label=comp,alpha=.85)
for _,r in fam.iterrows():
    lab=r.id.split("_")[1][:5]
    ax.annotate(lab,(r.net_charge,r.acidic),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,4),textcoords="offset points")
ax.set_xlabel("net charge, residues 1-34"); ax.set_ylabel("acidic residues, 1-34")
ax.set_title("C1-THF synthase family across eukaryotes\n(reviewed UniProt entries, n=%d)"%len(fam))
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=axes[1]
w=0.35; x=np.arange(2)
ax.bar(x-w/2,[mt.length.mean(),cy.length.mean()],w,color=["#d1495b","#4c8dbd"],edgecolor="k")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(["mitochondrial\n(n=%d)"%len(mt),"cytoplasmic\n(n=%d)"%len(cy)])
ax.set_ylabel("mean protein length (aa)"); ax.set_ylim(900,1000)
for xi,v in zip(x-w/2,[mt.length.mean(),cy.length.mean()]):
    ax.text(xi,v+2,f"{v:.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=10)
ax.set_title("Mitochondrial members are longer by\nroughly one presequence (%.0f aa)"%(mt.length.mean()-cy.length.mean()))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

fam.to_csv("/agent/jobs/1373acf3-bd7b-4d11-aee0-2f9a139d8765/provenance/C1THF_family_panel.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved provenance/C1THF_family_panel.csv")
